title: 日本ダービーの後に・汝が花開くは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, the racer who surpasses her limits and comes out on top is Sakura Chiyono O. However, in the heat of the race, Mejiro Ardan came close to accomplishing the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan acknowledges that it was her desire to defeat Sakura Chiyono O that allowed her to reach the gates to her limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She also realizes that she'd completely forgotten about her original goal of outshining her older sister, and something new dawns on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She learns that racing with her heart and soul against her cherished rivals, Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki, is the way to make her running shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While expressing the utmost gratitude to her rivals, who have elevated her to greater heights, Mejiro Ardan steps into a new world of possibilities!
